# scaling_inbound_integration (Data Source)

Looks up an inbound integration by name and exposes its id. Inbound integrations are provisioned out-of-band (for example by connecting a source via an OAuth install), so this data source lets a configuration reference one — for instance to manage its selectors with the scaling_inbound_integration resource — without hardcoding the generated id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an inbound integration that was installed out-of-band (for example by
# connecting a source in the UI) so its selectors can be managed in Terraform.
data "scaling_inbound_integration" "datadog" {
  name = "Datadog"
}

resource "scaling_inbound_integration" "datadog" {
  integration_id = data.scaling_inbound_integration.datadog.id

  selector {
    routing_policy_id = scaling_routing_policy.critical.id

    matcher {
      key   = "env"
      value = "prod"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the inbound integration to look up. Must be unique within the organization.

### Read-Only

- `component_id` (String) Component this integration's alerts resolve to.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the matched inbound integration.
- `org_id` (String) Organization that owns the integration.
- `routing_policy_id` (String) Routing policy applied when no selector row matches. Null means the org default policy.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-update timestamp.
